notes.title: FULL RELEASE: 4th map and return of Halloween
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This Halloween, I've got something special for you: [i]The Minka[/i]. It's an old Japanese house, complete with a creaky oriental deck, that too-quiet tatami room, and a pitch-black cave. I promise, it's designed to make you jump out of your seat a time or two.

With the release of this map, I'm saying goodbye to the early access stage. It's been a wild ride, especially with those pesky Unity hiccups recently. The game might not have blown up the charts, but every moment spent building it has meant the world to me. Your thoughts, comments, and even the critiques has been a huge help.

So, here's a big thanks for diving into the scares with me. If you're up for it, venture into [i]The Minka[/i]. And hey, keep the lights on this Halloween, just in case!

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All new map [i]The Minka[/i].
[*] Updated footstep sounds for tiles.
[*] Return of the pumpkins!
[/list]

[h3]The Minka[/h3]
[i]An eerie Japanese house, carved into the mountain, once visited by many, now stands silent and haunted.[/i]

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] Exquisite oriental deck!
[*] Sky-touching bamboo reeds!
[*] Spacious tatami room
[*] Golden rooster's allure?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/5341d491a3304d5fd9bf5d02330e14f127c29616.gif[/img]

[i]Until next time,[/i]

Tom

notes.title: Passive Skills
notes.notes:
[i]Unlocking new characters finally makes sense![/i]

All characters now have a passive skill. The first six ones have been given [b]Athletic[/b], which increases your stamina by 20%. The more interesting passives to spice up your gameplay are tied to the unlockable characters:
[list]
[*] [b]Tech-Savvy[/b]: 25% reduced module cooldown.
[*] [b]Muscular[/b]: 10% increased carry capacity.
[*] [b]Cold-Blooded[/b]: 20% less visible to monster.
[/list]

[h3]Minor changes to the Main Menu[/h3]

[b]UNLOCK menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Jumps to first locked item, if any. Skipping out-of-season unlockables.
[*] Passive skill added to the description of characters.
[/list]

[b]CHARACTER menu[/b]
[list]
[*] New window with description and passive skill of selected character.
[*] Small delay before reverting displayed character, when cursor leaves portrait.
[/list]

[h3]Wave Theme[/h3]

[i]Looking at the ocean is relaxing, so why not bring a piece of it along with you?[/i]

The new wave theme can be unlocked with 10 [b]Copper[/b] and 15 [b]Plastic[/b].

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Scavengers,[/h2]
it's only been a month since the release of FROM FEAR, but with Halloween quickly approaching, a spooky event is in order!

[h3]The Metro[/h3]
Starting from the 25th of October you'll be able to explore a completely new map: [b]The Metro[/b]. It boasts dimly lit hallways that'll send shivers down the spine of even the most experienced scavenger! Keep your eyes peeled and you might even come across two new types of resources: [b]Wires[/b] and [b]Rubber[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/15b998e713d5d7ba3d6445c3bba3b3350daf1746.gif[/img]

[h3]Pumpkins? Pumpkins![/h3]
Pumpkins have started sprouting up on all maps. What seemed like an isolated case has quickly grown into a large-scale infestation! Collect enough of this exotic resource and you'll be able to unlock a new character: [b]Esther, the vampire[/b].

More unlockables to spend your hard-earned pumpkins on will be released closer to Halloween.

[i]Pumpkins will be available from October 25 to November 1.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/a0f070a81f505d9d4ff6fe890a665a72dd8b86cd.gif[/img]

[i]Until next time,[/i]

Tom

notes.title: Difficulty Selection!
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone!
I read that some players had difficulties with the game, so I decided to introduce some options to make the experience more accessible.

The following difficulties can be selected when creating a lobby:

[b]Easy[/b]
[list]
[*] 25% increased grace and invisibility duration for monster.
[*] 0% chance to add extra aggro at the end of a hunt (Mega hunt starts at 10 aggro).
[*] 5% reduced speed when chasing players.
[/list]

[b]Normal[/b]
[list]
[*] This used to be the default.
[/list]

[b]Hard[/b]
[list]
[*] 20% decreased grace and invisibility duration for monster.
[*] 100% chance to add extra aggro at the end of a hunt (Mega hunt starts at 10 aggro).
[*] 2.5% increased speed when chasing players.
[*] Monster starts at 2 aggro.
[/list]

This update also contains a fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused crates in the first level not to be lootable.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/58877eb56870905e5acf6cdfd1ed8836ec13cb54.png[/img]

[h3]From Fear will release on Steam the 16th of September, 2022![/h3]

With special attention to player feedback, From Fear has changed and evolved since the demo was released. Here are some of the features and improvements that early access has in store:
[list]
[*] A second, larger map: [i]The Hotel[/i].
[*] A bus where you can drop off your resources.
[*] An [i]Omnitool[/i] with various modules to aid against the monster.
[*] An in-game store where you can unlock new map and modules.
[*] Completely reworked monster, which no longer pose a [i]constant[/i] threat.
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/DYaVwqYRjh]Discord Community[/url] to stay updated.


[i]Thank you so much for being a part of this[/i],

- Tom

notes.title: Second Map - March Progress
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/049bf64a8b264e73570d8a97de8015b8ac2816c7.png[/img]

In the [i]From Fear[/i] demo you were presented with a single map. A small derelict house in the forest, but you wanted more. You wanted bigger!

And so I'm really excited to present:


[b]The Hotel[/b]
With a size 2-3 times greater than the first map, this destination is a must for all scavengers! It's filled to the brim with resources (and secrets), but thread lightely as your fear still lurks in the shadows.

Key features:
[list]
[*] Huge courtyard
[*] Wide, airy corridors
[*] Private suites
[*] Messy dormitory
[/list]
[i]The Hotel[/i] will be released with early access later this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/7919e142d9566dbb48a150254b46ca96603e7989.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/3c36ea2e72e3e7467abe45cbd1496bb9d84dd995.gif[/img]


[b]A New Resource[/b]
While exploring [i]The Hotel[/i] you will eventually come across a completely new resource: Copper! Use it to upgrade your [i]Omnitool[/i] and unlock new levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/5fdbcf202eb959aec1c3d958a0750a897981a8c0.gif[/img]


[b]Randomized Loot[/b]
For early access, closed cardboard boxes (in the first map) and suitcases (in [i]The Hotel[/i]) will have a chance to contain one, or more, randomized resources. For you as a scavenger, this means more upgrade materials, but be prepared to adapt as your pockets fill up quickly.


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/DYaVwqYRjh]Discord Community[/url] to stay updated.


[i]Until next time[/i],

Tom

notes.title: Fear of Spiders - January Progress
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/58877eb56870905e5acf6cdfd1ed8836ec13cb54.png[/img]

The monster's behavior and third fear have been the primary focus of January. Some work still remains, but core features have been implemented and is ready for early access! I would like to use this occasion to also announce that the game's release date have been narrowed down to Q3, with a more detailed date coming soon.

[b]Monster Phases[/b]
The monster in the demo posed a constant threat, which left little room to actually search for more loot. This will change quite drastically for early access. The monster will now turn invisible from time to time. While the monster is invisible you can safely explore (although you'll still hear footprints and the monster will track noises). Just be careful when the monster suddenly materializes. There will also be a rare phase where the monster is much more aggressive and no player is safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/8435aca901362c9f3946cdf795544a0b0607d79d.gif[/img]


[b]Third Fear[/b]
The much anticipated [i]Fear of Spiders/Insects[/i] is now almost complete. This includes the monster, which will be the most complex one to date! While I would love to show it off, I'm afraid you'll have to wait a few months for the official trailer! Unique decoration, loot and a new [i]spectator[/i] have also been added. Prepare for creepy crawlies and slithery worms.

notes.title: December Progress - Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/58877eb56870905e5acf6cdfd1ed8836ec13cb54.png[/img]

Hope you're all staying safe and had a great holiday season!

December have been an eventful month with huge changes and progress made to the game. While the demo will no longer get more updates, rest assured that we're getting closer to the release of early access every day, with a release date coming later this year.

Big features and changes made during December:

[b]Crouching[/b]
With the ability to crouch, you can better hide from the monster. Use the newly added half-walls and stacks of loot to observe the monster without being spotted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/e9f96e25072ad36d6a6ae4eaed279952fd668c18.png[/img]


[b]Transition from Car to Bus[/b]
After a poll held on the game's Discord, players choose to replace the car with a bus. You will now be able to enter and leave anytime during the game, but so can the monster...

Two monitors inside the bus (front and back) will display requirements to finish the level. These will be, in order:
[olist]
[*] Collect the fuel.
[*] Gather alive players in the bus.
[*] Close all doors.
[/olist]
Be careful: The game cannot end while the monster is inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/da531d597e42626d21d0e760ebbb4e63680bec71.png[/img]


[b]The Omnitool[/b]
The Omnitool is a scavenger’s best friend. You will start off with a very weak version of this tool, handed to you by the merchants once you've faced your fears. This tool will have plenty of upgrades to invest in, with new modules to unlock which will give it completely new functionalities.
[list]
[*] The [b]Inspector Module[/b] will provide you with more information regarding what you're looking at, such as the exact number of resources found on an item or which key is needed to open a locked door.
[*] The [b]Noise Module[/b] places a noisy hologram at the target location, which can be used to lure the monster away from the player. Later upgrades will produce more noise and allow for placement further away.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/c2eddc91dc768348428a736a1b180df911bf1b52.png[/img]


[b]Transition from Money to Resources[/b]
Scavenging will now earn you resources instead of money! First level will provide you with wood, iron, fabric, paper, clay, and a rare [i]fear[/i] material. Later levels will unlock even more resource types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/93338b2de8f894d732d2a23502c0dd8745fb1bfe.png[/img]


[b]Store[/b]
You will be able to visit the store from the main menu. The mysterious merchant here can provide you access to new levels and upgrades for your omnitool if you can provide the required resources.


Check out the game's [url=https://trello.com/b/yJObkpw7/from-fear]Trello[/url] to follow updates more closely.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/DYaVwqYRjh]Discord Community[/url] to stay updated and vote in the next poll.

We finally have a website for [url=https://fromfeargame.com/]From Fear[/url]!


Happy new year,

Tom.

notes.title: Final update for the Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309262/58877eb56870905e5acf6cdfd1ed8836ec13cb54.png[/img]

Halloween is over, but a couple of major features still found their way into the demo.

[b]Drop Loot[/b]
Player can now drop their loot using the X key. You need to have at least one item in your inventory before you can drop it. All items are bundled together in a chest. If there is a key item in your inventory, the box shows as red. A chest is also spawned for dead or disconnected players.

[b]Fuel System Revamp[/b]
Now that fuel cannot disappear from the level anymore (through dead or disconnected players), the amounts have been changed. Single player now needs 3 fuel tanks, 5 for two players, 7 for three players and 9 for four players.

[b]Spectator Mode[/b]
Instead of going for a classic spectator mode, where you can check out what other players are seeing, I opted to go for something a little more interactive! Shortly after bleeding out, a "Fear Spectator" will be spawned above your head. The dead player will be given control over this spectator, which can fly around the map and still help out teammates by searching for fuel/medkits. Once proximity chat have been implemented, spectators will be able to communicate with alive players at reduced rates (Less range, lower volume). Oh, and they also come in random color variations!


[b]More Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Brightness
[*] Contrast
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Transitioned to Unity's new input system
[*] Increased minimum heartbeat distance from 5 to 7 meters.
[*] Increased random fuel locations from 8 to 20 - Some better hidden than others
[/list]


[i]Onward and upward,

Tom[/i]

notes.title: Demo Launch
notes.notes:
[h3]Demo[/h3]
The demo is finally here and I'm really excited for all of you to try it out!

[h3]Version 1.0.3[/h3]
The demo will continue to get minor updates and patches until Halloween. A more significant one, 1.0.3, have just been released.

[b]Baiting[/b]
Lots of players have commented how the monster could be baited around the car to simplify the game. Few changes have been introduced in regards to this:
[list]
[*] The fear realm now build up much slower. (30 seconds, instead of 5 seconds)
[*] Staying in the realm will slow down the player over time. This effect is minor at first, but increases faster and faster! Once 30 seconds have passed, the player will no longer be able to outrun the monster.
[/list]

[b]More settings[/b]
Some highly requested settings have been added to the in-game settings menu. These are:
[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity
[*] General volume
[*] Menu music (volume)
[/list]

[h3]Version 1.0.5[/h3]
A few significant changes have been made to make the monster more difficult to bait, while reducing some of the current player disadvantages.
[list]
[*] The monster's angle of perception have been increased from 50 degrees to 70 degrees
[*] The monster will not switch target, if current target is visible and within 2 meters
[*] New target need to be at least 50% closer than current target to "steal aggro"
[*] Player slow-down effect have been reduced. The monster now gets faster instead. This speed boost carries over when switching target!
[/list]


[h3]What's to come?[/h3]
Some of the features that will appear in the Early Access are:
[list]
[*] 1-2 more fears
[*] 1 new map
[*] In-game store
[*] Proximity chat
[*] Crouching
[*] Controller support
[/list]
...and much more! If you want to follow the development closely, consider joining the [url=https://discord.com/invite/DYaVwqYRjh]Official Discord[/url] or check out [url=https://trello.com/b/yJObkpw7/from-fear]From Fear's Trello[/url].



[i]Onward and upward,

Tom[/i]
